audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..6].side are all 'Skill' with Alistar-favoring .why text, but content win[0..6] are all 'Xerath' and packet.levelChart is also all Xerath across all 7 rows.
audit.why: win[N] already reads 'Xerath' for all seven rows and matches packet.levelChart, so per the chart rule only the full layer needs to move — no win[N] edit needed since it would be a no-op.
audit.corrected: Moved all 7 phases[N].side to 'Xerath', adjusted phases[N].rating down to reflect Xerath favor throughout, and rewrote each .why to state the real reason (his range/poke/stun kit) instead of the old Alistar-favoring text.

audit.why: spikes[] correctly identify level 2 (E stun before you close), level 6 (Unbreakable Will cleanses the E stun through R barrage), first item (mobility item lets you flash onto him), and late (E-Q-R chunks/deletes from range) — all grounded in real names.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flagged that Rite of the Arcane (R) is a channel and Alistar's own hard CC (Triumphant Roar (P), Trample (E)) cancels it outright — this fact was absent from the page.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule 'channel-interruptible' applies directly and was unstated.
audit.corrected: Replaced the copy-paste-bled dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d with the channel-interrupt fact.

edits.after: Xerath's Q and E out-range your entire kit — you eat poke before you're ever in melee range.

edits.before: W-Q online — the combo is live and every squishy support is now flash-range nervous.
edits.after: Shocking Orb (E) stun shuts your walk-up down — his poke keeps control on his side.

edits.before: Full kit: headbutt-pulverize the carry off any wave state; trample the disengage.
edits.after: Layered Arcanopulse (Q) chunks every step in — you still can't reach him safely.

edits.before: Zone with combo threat — their carry farms at the range your W defines.
edits.after: His sustained range damage out-trades your zero-range kit at every step.

edits.before: Unbreakable Will online — tower dives become appointments; the cow ignores the counter-CC.

edits.before: First item: the front line holds and the combos chain into jungler arrivals.

edits.before: Late Alistar opens and survives: combo the carry, ult the focus, and trample the cleanup.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Standing still while he channels R — any of your CC cancels it, so punish the channel, don't eat it.
